name: web_search
description: High-speed live web search, page reading, multi-source research, and verification via agent-wire.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the live web and platforms. Returns numbered results with the top hit automatically deep-read in compressed markdown.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a public web page or supported platform URL (X, Reddit, GitHub, YouTube, HN, arXiv, etc.) and return clean, token-compressed text.

tools.name: wire_research
tools.description: Synthesize a cited intelligence brief on a topic across Hacker News, Reddit, GitHub, YouTube, and the web over the last N days.

topic.description: Topic or comparison (e.g. 'local llms' or 'Bun vs Deno').

tools.name: wire_cite
tools.description: Verify citations and links in text: checks for dead links, missing quotes, or unsourced claims.

text.description: Text containing links or claims to verify.
